name: Mooring coordinator
design: Large muscular adult with sand-yellow spotted skin and broad exposed mandibles, black dreadlocks in single thick nape knot. Open-sided dark-grey padded work vest over black wrap shirt, brass harness rings, dark long work skirt split to knee, forearm wraps. A neatly coiled thick alien mooring cable over left shoulder held by one hand, small locking hook attached safely at belt; other hand on hip.
